tasks.DefinePolynomialRange: Define the range of the polynomial function |ax^2 + bx + c| for x in [0,1].
tasks.EvaluateAtEndpoints: Evaluate the polynomial at the endpoints x=0 and x=1.
tasks.FindCoefficientsBounds: Determine the bounds on coefficients a, b, and c based on the given constraints.
tasks.MaximizeExpression: Maximize |a| + |b| + |c| under the derived coefficient bounds.
